testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.chat.ChatContentTranscriptTest

testcase.name: the free marker follows the selected model and is absent otherwise
no free marker is rendered for a paid model
the model picker is visible on a new chat with no selection
the header never shows a stale connecting phase once ready
unknown parts render a visible fallback
a finish flag without a result still reads running
empty cold-start state explains how the engine starts
the resume bar shows only when the target is not the active session
the resume bar is hidden when the active session is the target
streaming shows Stop and not Send
reasoning renders collapsed and expands on tap
retry on a failed reply re-sends the preceding user prompt
the picker falls back to a suffix-stripped id when the name is blank
populated transcript renders both roles and marks the assistant affordances
a failed engine empty state shows the failure, not cold-start copy
